lines.en: For how long did the writer give up smoking?
After reading an article entitled 'Cigarette Smoking and Your Health' I lit a cigarette to calm my nerves.
lines.cn: 在读完一篇题为《吸烟与健康》的文章后，我点燃了一支烟来缓解自己的紧张情绪。

lines.en: I smoked with concentration and pleasure as I was sure that this would be my last cigarette.
lines.cn: 我专注而愉悦地抽着这支烟，因为我知道这将是我的最后一支烟了。

lines.en: For a whole week I did not smoke at all and during this time my wife suffered terribly.
lines.cn: 整整一个星期里，我都没有抽烟；而在这期间，我的妻子却承受了极大的痛苦。

lines.en: I had all the usual symptoms of someone giving up smoking: a bad temper and an enormous appetite.
lines.cn: 我出现了所有典型的戒烟后症状：脾气变得暴躁，食欲变得异常旺盛。

lines.en: My friends kept on offering me cigarettes and cigars.
lines.cn: 我的朋友们一直不停地给我提供香烟和雪茄。

lines.en: They made no effort to hide their amusement whenever I produced a packet of sweets from my pocket.
lines.cn: 每当我从口袋里掏出一包糖果时，他们总是毫不掩饰自己的开心和兴奋。

lines.en: After seven days of this I went to a party.
lines.cn: 经过七天的这种状态后，我参加了一个派对。

lines.en: Everybody around me was smoking and I felt extremely uncomfortable.
lines.cn: 我周围的每个人都在抽烟，这让我感到非常不舒服。

lines.en: When my old friend Brian urged me to accept a cigarette, it was more than I could bear.
lines.cn: 当我的老朋友布莱恩坚持要我抽一支烟时，我真的再也无法忍受了。

lines.en: I took one guiltily, lit it and smoked with satisfaction.
lines.cn: 我带着一丝内疚感拿了一支烟，点燃它后，心满意足地抽了起来。

lines.en: My wife was delighted that things had returned to normal once more.
lines.cn: 我的妻子很高兴，因为一切终于恢复了正常。

lines.en: Anyway, as Brian pointed out, it is the easiest thing in the world to give up smoking.
lines.cn: 无论如何，正如布莱恩指出的那样，戒烟其实是一件非常容易的事情。

lines.en: He himself has done it lots of times!
lines.cn: 他自己也做过很多次了！
